notes: Sponsor (seq 3 of 7) of BL2023-1731, which amends Metro Code 2.149.040 to make PERMANENT the requirement that at least twenty percent of Barnes Fund for Affordable Housing grants be set aside for small nonprofits (operating budget under $4M, housing budget under $1M) creating or preserving affordable housing. It had been mandatory only for FY2022-23 and aspirational after. The instrument is the design of a targeted public SUBSIDY programme, not a single appropriation. Chair 2 is excluded: no rent cap and no inclusionary requirement appears. Chair 1 is excluded: the vehicle is grants to nonprofits, not government construction and operation. Same chair as Gadd, reached independently through a different ordinance.
